description.value: Good Co. Bars is a multi-location Vancouver bar and restaurant chain with its Main Street outpost anchoring the Mount Pleasant neighbourhood. The venue blends pub-style dining with sports viewing, games, and a busy events calendar including trivia nights, dance parties, and TV watch parties. Touring cyclists will find a full food menu with substantial meal options in a lively, social setting.

bike_parking_detail: 12 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 30m; rack (10 spaces) at 35m; stands (2 spaces) at 39m; stands (5 spaces) at 58m; stands (2 spaces) at 60m; rack at 77m; stands (2 spaces) at 80m; stands (2 spaces) at 89m; rack (8 spaces) at 90m; stands (4 spaces) at 91m; stands (2 spaces) at 95m; stands (2 spaces) at 99m. Total: 41 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Good Co. Main Street location at 2904 Main St, Vancouver (Mount Pleasant), matching the OSM address exactly. The menu shows numerous vegetarian and vegan options (Veggie Burger, Sofritas Tacos, Veggie Dumplings, Glory Bowl with tofu, gluten-free vegan bun substitution) providing clear evidence for that amenity. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM record and none visible on website.
Website is a multi-location brand site; the OSM record refers specifically to the Main Street (Mount Pleasant) location, which the website confirms at 2904 Main St.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible bar and restaurant confirmed by an up-to-date website with current events and a full menu.
